1 of 12 ambient reads (REBAR_RECONCILER_VERBOSE in outbound_fields.py) must be owned in-place with a # read-via: marker, with all other listed reads unmarked.
The 12 LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS rows in scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py must be removed after refactoring, leaving zero exceptions for the 6 affected adapter files.
